name: open.quiz
description: Open Quiz is a full-stack quiz platform featuring guided learning paths, interactive quizzes, and progress tracking, built with React, Node.js, and Express.
author: DanyloHet,kwishart24,berenicerojas,BytesOfStrength,mnichols08

scripts.setup: npm i && npm --prefix backend i && npm --prefix frontend i && ./setup.sh
scripts.dev:sprout: dotenv -e instances/sprout/settings.env -e instances/sprout/.env -e .env -- npm-run-all --parallel --race -l development:backend development:frontend
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run format && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e:all
